subtitle: Your installed APWorlds, and the community catalog to add more.
dropHint: Or drop an .apworld anywhere in the app.

noMatch.title: No world matches
noMatch.body: Try another search, or remove some filters.

ok.label: Ready
ok.help: Archipelago loads this world when it starts.

no-manifest.label: No manifest
no-manifest.help: It has no archipelago.json file: it works with Archipelago 0.6, but will not load with Archipelago 0.7.

incompatible.label: Incompatible
incompatible.help: It is not made for your Archipelago version, which will not load it.

corrupt.label: Corrupt
corrupt.help: The file cannot be read, and Archipelago refuses to start while it is there. Disable or remove it.

shadowed.label: Shadowed
shadowed.help: Another version of the same game comes first: Archipelago ignores this file.

core-loose.label: Built in
core-loose.help: Shipped with Archipelago as a folder: this world cannot be replaced.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.help: Set aside by ArchipelaGOAT: Archipelago does not load it. Enable it again whenever you like.

bad-name.label: Wrong name
bad-name.help: Its file name is not the name of its inner folder: Archipelago cannot load it. Rename it in one click.

installed.restartHint: Restart the open Archipelago programs so that they notice.
installed.corruptBody_one: An unreadable file keeps Archipelago from starting. Disable or remove it.
installed.corruptBody_other: {{count}} unreadable files keep Archipelago from starting. Disable or remove them.
installed.emptyBody: Pick some from the community catalog, or drop an .apworld file anywhere in the app.

remove.title: Remove {{game}}?
remove.body: {{file}} goes to the ArchipelaGOAT backups: you can get it back by hand if you need it.

catalog.checkUpdate: Look for a later release on GitHub
catalog.checkUpdateOf: Look for a later release of {{game}}
catalog.downloadPageHelp: Opens its download page in your browser. ArchipelaGOAT cannot install it by itself: drop the .apworld file into the app afterwards.
catalog.romHelp: Generating a game needs your own ROM of it. ArchipelaGOAT never provides one.
catalog.popTrackerHelp: A PopTracker pack exists to track your progress.
catalog.disabledHelp: The community index marks this world as not working with the installed Archipelago version, or as withdrawn. ArchipelaGOAT does not install it.
catalog.hiddenAfterDarkHint: The “18+ worlds” setting hides them. You can hide them again in Settings.
catalog.wikiHelp: Listed only on the Archipelago wiki: this world is not in the ionium-ap community index, and nobody else has checked it.
catalog.emptyBody: Nothing to show for now. Try again in a moment.
catalog.creditsWiki: Statuses, maintainers, categories and game images: <wiki>Archipelago wiki</wiki>, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

ready.title: Ready to play: {{game}}
ready.notInCatalog: {{game}} is not in the catalog: “Ready to play” cannot start from this world.

noAp.title: Archipelago is not installed
noAp.body: “Ready to play” installs the world and makes your YAML with Archipelago. Install it first, then come back here.

trust.verified: A world of the community index with a verified checksum: “Install and prepare” is your confirmation.
trust.changed: This world’s trust level changed since the dialog opened: read the warning before going on.

profile.label: Profile
profile.afterInstall: Checks and changes are worked out after the install: the profile you pick is built then.

name.label: Player name
name.hint: 16 characters at most. Empty: Player1, Player2…

destination.label: Destination
destination.fileHint: You pick where to save it when the preparation starts.
destination.studioHint: The YAML opens in the Studio, to fine-tune it before saving it.
destination.studioDirty: The Studio’s unsaved draft will be replaced.

done.title: Ready!
done.renamed: Added as “{{name}}”: “{{asked}}” was already taken in this session.
done.studio: The YAML of {{game}} is in the Studio

notes.title: Good to know
notes.romBody: You need your own ROM of {{game}} to generate the game: ArchipelaGOAT provides none.
notes.popTrackerBody: A PopTracker pack exists to follow your progress.
notes.guideBody: The wiki explains how to install and launch {{game}}.
notes.restartBody: Its open programs will only see {{game}} after a restart.
notes.runningBody: Archipelago programs are open: restart them if they do not find {{game}}.
notes.unrefinedBody: {{game}} could not be measured: this {{profile}} profile is picked from its option names alone, with no guarantee on its check count.
